title: Claims Payments Standard: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Payments, Exclusions and Receipts
content:
## A. Charges never paid

Cardinal Rental Reimbursement never pays the following:
- the agency's damage waiver, on an option where the damage waiver is not covered;
- fuel;
- per-mile charges;
- one-way drop fees;
- under-25 renter fees;
- counter deposits;
- accessories;
- the difference for a larger car than authorized.

Delivery and collection fees, additional driver fees and child safety seats are paid only where the option's switch for that charge is on, and only within the daily limit. Everything not paid is the customer's responsibility and is recorded on the payment.

## Limits these payments are measured against

The daily limit and the per-loss maximum used in every payment are those of the option the claim is paid under:

| Option | Daily limit | Per-loss maximum |
|---|---|---|
| 30/900 | $30.00 | $900.00 |
| 40/1200 | $40.00 | $1200.00 |
| 50/1500 | $50.00 | $1500.00 |
| 60/1800 | $60.00 | $1800.00 |
| 75/2250 | $75.00 | $2250.00 |
| 100/3000 | $100.00 | $3000.00 |

## B. Agency invoices

B.1 Direct-bill invoices are paid to the partner agency within the option's invoice payment days.

B.2 An invoice is reviewed before payment if it exceeds the authorized days multiplied by the daily limit by more than the option's invoice review amount.

*Boundary illustration (hypothetical invoice, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200, review amount $25.00):* 7 authorized days multiplied by the $40.00 daily limit is $280.00. An invoice of $305.00 exceeds that by exactly $25.00, which is not more than the review amount, so it is not reviewed on that ground. An invoice of $305.01 exceeds it by $25.01 and is reviewed before payment.

## C. Reimbursement to the customer

C.1 A customer who arranged their own rental, or who used rideshare, taxi or transit where the option allows it, is reimbursed against itemized receipts under the same daily limit. Reimbursement is paid within the option's reimbursement payment days of complete receipts.

C.2 Receipts are reimbursed only when submitted no later than the option's receipt submission days, counted in calendar days after the rental ended. The count runs from the end date of the closed authorization, and that date is day 0. Receipts received on the last day are in time.

*Boundary case (hypothetical dates, 60-day window):* An authorization closed with an end date of March 1. Day 60 is April 30. Receipts received on April 30 are in time. Receipts received on May 1 are not reimbursed.

## D. Clauses no longer in force

The following former payment clauses are **no longer in force**. They are superseded by the current basis for the payment concerned, and they are kept here only as retired text:

- *Retired:* each covered rental day is paid at the lower of the agency's daily rate and the option's daily limit, with taxes and fees counted inside the limit; only days inside the authorization are covered, and the total on the claim never exceeds the per-loss maximum.
- *Retired:* within those limits, the payment is the covered days multiplied by the covered daily amount, capped at what the per-loss maximum still allows.
- *Retired:* an agency invoice is paid only once; an invoice number already paid is not paid again.

superseded_clauses: Each covered rental day is paid at the lower of the agency's daily rate and the option's daily_limit, taxes and fees counted inside the limit where daily_limit_includes_taxes; only days inside the authorization are covered, and the total on the claim never exceeds max_per_loss.
Within those limits the payment is the covered days times the covered daily amount, capped at what the per-loss maximum still allows (rental_msr_benefit_used).
An agency invoice is paid only once; an invoice number already paid is not paid again.
